title: Tribunals
tagline: Tribunal is a decentralized NFT-based voting system for DAOs.
description:
Tribunal is a decentralised NFT-based voting system for DAOs. DAOs can issue NFTs to wallets based on what matters to the community and the holders of these NFTs can create proposals and vote.

DAOs create a tribunal on the app and the get a custom mint page. Only holders of the NFTs from a tribunal  can vote for/against proposals of their DAO.
how_its_made:
Built with Moralis for auth, Polygon to mint NFTs, Published on Vercel and app data on IPFS. Login with unstoppable domains is also integrated. 

The app was built with ReactJS, Tailwind and Vite. The smart contract developed on Remix  is published on the Polygon Mainnet. The app backend is built with NodeJS and uses a MongoDB database
